title: Applied Microbiology and Infection Control including Safety

syllabusSource.title: Indian Nursing Council, Revised Regulations and Curriculum for B.Sc. (Nursing) Program, Regulations 2020 (Gazette of India, 5 July 2021), Applied Microbiology and Infection Control including Safety, pages 291–297; exam pattern in Appendix 3, pages 416–417

units.title: Introduction to microbiology and general characteristics of microbes
Laboratory identification: staining, culture media and culture methods
Pathogenic organisms: bacteria, viruses, fungi, parasites, rodents and vectors
Hospital acquired infections, isolation precautions, PPE and hand hygiene
Disinfection and sterilization, specimen collection, biomedical waste, laundry and antibiotic stewardship
Patient safety indicators, incidents and International Patient Safety Goals
